Phantom Blade Zero - I Played the First Two Chapters...
In this Fextralife video, I'm going to be talking about my hands-on impressions with Phantom Blade Zero. Recently, I got to play the first two chapters of the game I played a little bit at Gamescom, and then I was invited by S-Game to go play in Beijing at an event they had there. which is over in my side of the world, which is kind of nice.
